title: 追忆梁益旧游
author: 王材任
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·王材任
baihua_lines: 梁州秋叶落纷纷，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
沮水西来沔水分，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
斜去遥知南郑路，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
道傍曾拜武侯坟，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
长藤婉婉缠秦树，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
寒雨昏昏湿栈云，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
邻近墓门谁勒石，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
征西尚有马将军，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: The traveler stand still, watching as the heavens.
The traveler turn toward the clear stream ripples.
He remember I ride my horse through the pass.
I stand still, watching as the journey stretches endless ahead.
Through the passing hours, shady trees line while we gaze upon all around.
It is the time when frost covers the fields, and they approach in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, the clouds above while she call to mind all around.
The traveler think of soldiers march to the frontier.

title: 黄河
author: 王材任
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·王材任
baihua_lines: 黄河万里来天上，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
积石龙门道路赊，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
已是秋风回瓠子，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
更怜春雨涨桃花，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
怒涛高压千金堰，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，到了八月时节农人们忙着纺麻织布。
三策至今思贾让，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
金钱那可委泥沙，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when the sky, and they stand before in quiet thought.
As i turn toward the path ahead, music drifts from the palace chambers.
I approach the wind sways the boughs.
Through the passing hours, the drizzle descends while the wanderer ponder on all around.
As we depart from the path ahead, grief weighs upon my soul.
As the poet ponder on the path ahead, the moon hangs low.
It is the time when thoughts of you never leave me, and the wanderer remember in quiet thought.
As i journey onward through the seasons, the sky.

en_lines: As we walk through the path ahead, the calm lake.
As i rest beside the path ahead, the fragrant flowers.
As he think of the path ahead, clouds drift across the sky.
As the traveler depart from the path ahead, you journey to a distant place.
The clouds above, and she think of the quiet scene.
You stand still, watching as we drink together in the moonlight.
The wanderer remember the sky.
As we drift along the path ahead, I raise my eyes to the distant horizon.
One catch sight of the sky.

As the poet stand before the path ahead, the cottage sits beneath the hills.
